name: maxio-mcp
description: Open, local revenue-intelligence CLI for Maxio Advanced Billing  -  MRR waterfalls, retention, and per-client history computed offline from a SQLite mirror, so the trended history survives even though the live API returns only point-in-time figures.

maxio_api_key.title: Maxio API key
maxio_api_key.description: Your Maxio Advanced Billing API key (Config > Integrations > API Keys). Sent only to your site's Maxio host as the HTTP Basic username with the constant password x.

maxio_base_url.title: Maxio API base URL
maxio_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from MAXIO_SITE. Set it only to point at a different host.

maxio_password.title: MAXIO_PASSWORD (legacy)
maxio_password.description: Earlier versions' Basic password; Maxio API keys always use x. Leave blank.

maxio_site.title: Maxio site
maxio_site.description: Your Advanced Billing subdomain: acme for acme.chargify.com.

maxio_username.title: MAXIO_USERNAME (legacy)
maxio_username.description: Earlier versions' form of the API key. Leave blank when MAXIO_API_KEY is set (it wins).

maxio_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
maxio_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Leave blank to expose every tool; a call that changes Maxio still needs confirm set to true.

maxio_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
maxio_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, nothing is written to the local store, and sync and the revenue commands that read it refuse to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

maxio_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
maxio_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default stdio transport.

maxio_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
maxio_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Maxio requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
